sections.Profile:
The "Jig Saw" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in November 1957, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. The machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, two slingshots, two kick-out holes, and a gobble hole.
